messages:
ops-bot: INCIDENT: High error rate on /v1/embeddings (prod). Alert: embeddings-5xx-rate > 5% over 5m. Paging mike_oncall. Link: https://internal.redwood/alerts/311223 

mike_oncall: on it. looking at charts now. 

sara_sre: seeing large fanout from a handful of IP ranges, multiple ASNs. lots of small requests and retries. 429s and 502s spiking, peak ~90k rps to embeddings endpoints. customer error rate ~10% for some tenants. 

mike_oncall: can we temporarily disable async batching for public embeddings to reduce fanout/backpressure? should reduce inter-service fanout spikes. 

deploy-bot: runbook hint: disable-embeddings-batching -> POST /internal-admin/flags/embeddings-batching {"enabled":false} (requires admin token). 

leo_prodeng: doing that now. curl snippet: ```curl -X POST https://internal-admin/flags/embeddings-batching -H 'Authorization: $ADMIN' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"enabled":false}'``` 

deploy-bot: Feature flag "embeddings-batching" set to false by leo_prodeng. 

ops-bot: Observability: p95 latency for embeddings down 12% in 2m, outbound kv-cache pressure reduced. queue depth on embedding-workers decreased. 

sara_sre: toggled WAF rule 214 to block the top offending ASN list + common scraper UA signatures. also enabling geo-rate-slice for APAC (fraction: 0.2) to preserve capacity for authenticated traffic. 

security-bot: WAF rule 214 applied. Blocking ~120k req/min from those ranges. Estimated false-positive rate ~0.2% based on sample. 

irene_support: customer-impact check: internal incidents board shows six high-volume customers with elevated 429s, top three account for ~65% of impacted requests. Preparing customer notifications. Template: "We're seeing transient embedding errors and have applied temporary mitigations (batching disabled, WAF filters). We're monitoring and will follow up." 

mike_oncall: agreed. send notices to top 3, update ops status page: note batching disabled + mitigation steps. assign follow-up for quota adjustments. 

sara_sre: after current mitigations error rate down to ~1.1% overall, tail latency improving. continuing to observe for 15m before wider rollback. plan: leave batching off for now and create a dedicated quota-slice for suspicious IPs to avoid collateral damage. 

leo_prodeng: added a short-lived dynamic quota rule: unauthenticated traffic -> 50 rps per source token; authenticated managed customers unaffected. applied via config: ```kubectl apply -f /deploy/quota/unauth-quickcap.yaml``` 

irene_support: customer comms sent to accounts A/B/C. ops status updated (incident note + mitigation list). 

mike_oncall: handing off monitoring to sara_sre for the overnight window. next oncall alex_oncall in ~6h if still open. please capture all actions in incident ticket and create a postmortem owner. 

sara_sre: taking handoff. I'll run hourly checks and escalate if error rate rises above 2% or new large ASNs appear. saving charts and logs to the incident ticket. 

deploy-bot: paging resolved for oncall (ack). Ongoing monitoring active. PagerDuty incident PD-311223 created for tracking. 

mike_oncall: :thumbsup: good job everyone. Postmortem owner assigned: leo_prodeng. we'll include mitigation timeline, config diffs, and recommendations (rate-slicing by client, smarter batching circuit-breaker).
